categories.destructive: Deletions, setup changes and dispute replies

settings.title: Actions
settings.description: Choose which actions Hay.chat must ask a person about before it runs them in your store.

approval.title: Approval before actions run
approval.description: When an action needs approval, Hay.chat tells the customer it has requested it and waits. A person approves or declines it from the conversation or the Inbox.
approval.master: Ask a person before these actions run
approval.masterOffHint: Approval is off. Hay.chat runs every action straight away, except those a playbook asks approval for.
approval.unclassifiedNote: Deletions, setup changes and actions from integrations that do not say what they do always need approval while approval is on.

threshold.label: Auto-approve refunds and discounts up to
threshold.help: In the order's currency. Refunds and discounts at or below this amount run without approval. 0 means every one needs approval. Cancellations always need approval while they are switched on.

confirmation.title: Customer confirmation
confirmation.description: Before an action, Hay.chat tells the customer exactly what it will do and asks "Shall I go ahead?". It only continues after the customer replies.
confirmation.label: Ask the customer to confirm first
confirmation.cancelNote: Always on for cancellations, even when this is switched off.

approvers.title: Who can approve
approvers.description: The owner can always approve. Choose which other roles can approve or decline actions.

settings.ownerOnly: Only the organization owner can switch approval off, raise the auto-approve amount or change who approves. You can still switch approval on.

typedConfirm.title: Switch approval off?
typedConfirm.description: These actions will run without anyone seeing them first: {list}.

playbook.title: Approval in this playbook
playbook.description: While this playbook is active, these actions always wait for a person, even under the auto-approve amount or when approval is off in Settings > Actions. A playbook can only add approval, never remove it.
playbook.orgRequired: Already needs approval in Settings > Actions

approvals.title: Waiting for your approval
approvals.description: Actions the AI asked to run. Nothing happens until someone decides.
approvals.selectHint: Select requests of one kind to approve them together.
approvals.amountHelp: You can only lower it, never raise it.
approvals.rejectReason: Reason (the AI uses it to explain to the customer)
approvals.approvedFailed: Approved, but it failed when it ran. The AI will tell the customer it was not done.
approvals.rejected: Declined. The AI will let the customer know.
approvals.conversationClosed: This conversation is closed, so nothing ran. Reopen it to approve, or decline.
approvals.invalidAmount: The amount can only be lowered and must be above zero.
approvals.bulkPartial: {done} approved, {notDone} not done. Check them in their conversations.

graduation.message: You approved {approved} of {total} {category} requests in the last 30 days, the largest {amount}. Auto-approve refunds and discounts up to {amount}?
graduation.confirmDescription: Refunds and discounts at or below {amount} will run without asking a person. Larger ones still wait for approval. You can change this in Settings > Actions.
graduation.applied: Refunds and discounts up to {amount} now run without approval.
graduation.applyFailed: Could not change the auto-approve amount

codes.BAD_INPUT: The AI sent details the store could not accept, such as a wrong order number or format.
codes.NOT_FOUND: The store could not find the order, customer or item the AI asked for.
codes.PRECONDITION: The order's current state does not allow this action.
codes.AUTH_FAILED: The connection to this integration expired or was revoked. Reconnect it in Integrations.
codes.SCOPE_MISSING: The integration is missing a permission this action needs. Reconnect it in Integrations and allow the access it asks for.
codes.RATE_LIMITED: The store is getting too many requests right now. It should work again in a few minutes.
codes.PROVIDER_DOWN: The store's service did not respond. Try again later.
codes.OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: The store did not confirm whether this went through. Check the order in your store before trying again.
codes.NEEDS_APPROVAL: This is above the limit set for the integration, so it needs a person's approval.
codes.INTERNAL: Something unexpected went wrong while running this action.
codes.APPROVAL_REJECTED: A team member declined this request.

reasons.ALREADY_HAS_COUPON: This customer already has an unused coupon.
reasons.GOODWILL_CHECK_INCOMPLETE: It could not be confirmed that this customer has no unused goodwill coupon, so none was created.
reasons.EXCEEDS_REFUNDABLE: The amount is more than what can still be refunded on this order.
reasons.CUSTOMER_MISMATCH: The order does not belong to this customer.
reasons.NOT_SUPPORTED: The store does not support this action.
reasons.RECORD_ONLY_NOT_ALLOWED: This order was paid through a payment gateway, so a refund cannot just be recorded without paying the money back.
reasons.OUT_OF_STOCK: The item is out of stock.
reasons.NO_EMAIL: There is no email address to send to.
reasons.NO_CUSTOMER: No customer is linked to this order.
reasons.NO_ACCOUNT: This customer has no account in the store.
reasons.NOT_PAID: The order has not been paid.
reasons.IDENTITY_MISMATCH: The customer's details do not match the order.
reasons.FULFILLMENT_IN_PROGRESS: The order is already being prepared for shipping.
reasons.EMAIL_MISMATCH: The email given does not match the order.
reasons.COUPON_CREATE_FAILED: The store could not create the coupon.
reasons.COUPONS_DISABLED: Coupons are turned off in the store.
reasons.BALANCE_DUE: The change would leave the customer with an amount to pay, so nothing was changed.
reasons.UNSUPPORTED_WC_VERSION: The store's software version does not support this action.
reasons.PRICE_HIGHER: The new item costs more than what the customer paid.
reasons.PENDING_REFUND: A refund is already in progress for this order.
reasons.NOT_PRE_DISPATCH: The order has moved past the stage where it can still be changed.
reasons.NOT_PENDING: The order is not awaiting payment, so there is no payment link to send.
reasons.FULLY_REFUNDED: The order has already been fully refunded.
reasons.EMAIL_FAILED: The email could not be sent.
reasons.DIFFERENT_PRODUCT: A swap can only change the size or colour of the same product.
reasons.ALREADY_DISPATCHED: The order has already been dispatched.

log.title: Action log
log.description: Every tool call the AI made in conversations, newest first. An approved action shows twice: once when it was sent for approval and once when it ran.
log.empty: No actions yet. Tool calls the AI makes will show up here.
log.loadFailed: Could not load the action log
